asked.item: No choose platforms step before AI writes
How to ask for one Facebook and one LinkedIn post

verdict.reason: The FAQ states that platforms are named in the chat prompt and gives an example for LinkedIn and Facebook.

steps.text: In the AI Agent there is no separate "select platforms" step before generating.
Instead, name the platforms in your chat prompt, for example: "Using my context, create one LinkedIn post and one Facebook post."
Blotato generates one draft per platform you ask for.
